name: How long does a typical window installation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window installation project varies based on the number and type of windows, as well as the complexity of the installation. For a standard home with 10-15 windows, the process usually takes between one to three days. This includes removing old windows, preparing the openings, installing new units, sealing, and finishing. Larger projects or those involving custom windows, significant structural adjustments, or unforeseen issues may take longer. Your contractor will provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical window installation for 10-15 windows usually takes 1-3 days, depending on window type and project complexity. Larger or custom projects may take longer.
